utterance: The `ledger-vpc` VPC (10.60.0.0/22) is the ledger platform's network. Create two subnets in it, one in us-east-1a and one in us-east-1b, and create an EC2 instance in each subnet: the latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI, t2.micro instance type, and an attached EBS volume of 50 GB.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: the ledger-vpc VPC holds two new subnets, one in us-east-1a and one in us-east-1b, each on a range of its own inside 10.60.0.0/22, and each of those two subnets runs one new EC2 instance of type t2.micro launched from the latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI with a 50 GB EBS root volume
